Lifecycle Transitions (packages/contracts/src/transitions.ts): T1 (scope.captured, G1: ROOM_CREATED -> SCOPED), T2 (task.dispatched.planner, G2: SCOPED -> PLANNING), T3 (plan.submitted, G3: PLANNING -> PLAN_REVIEW), T4 (plan.revision_requested, G4: PLAN_REVIEW -> PLANNING), T5 (plan.approved, G5: PLAN_REVIEW -> BUILDING), and T22 (founder.cancel, G22: non-terminal state -> CLOSED_ABANDONED). 3. Journal Specs and Tables (packages/journal/src/event-row.ts, packages/journal/src/decision-row.ts, packages/control-plane/src/journal-store.ts): command-event rows use SPEC_ID_C ('BRJ:c:1') or SPEC_ID_C2 ('BRJ:c:2', adding initModel and providerConversationId on dispatched events) with COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES ('journaled', 'identity_bound', 'dispatched', 'completed', 'failed', 'unresolved', 'resolved'); decision rows use SPEC_ID_D ('BRJ:d:1') for DECISION_EVENTS ('plan.revision_requested', 'plan.approved', 'founder.cancel'); rows are stored in public.command_journal_events with chain head in public.command_journal_chain_head via public.command_journal_append. 4. Plan Store Contract (packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts): PlanStore.recordPlan validates the PlanDocV1 via judgePlanDoc, refuses credential material via containsCredentialMaterial, verifies via LIFECYCLE_SQL that the referenced public.build_room_events row is a plan.submitted transition with matching planHash and (e.xmin = pg_current_xact_id()::xid) AS this_transaction, and inserts into public.build_room_plans.
data_flow: 1. Scope Capture (T1): The Founder posts scope.captured to POST /rooms/:roomId/events with facts.founderGoal, repository, baseSha, and canonical scopePaths; prepareFounderGoal attaches the SHA-256 founder_goal evidence digest and the room moves ROOM_CREATED -> SCOPED. 2. Round Opening (T2 + journaled): When invoked through the counted-run surface (POST /control-plane/counted-runs/rooms/:roomId/planner-round), PlannerLoop.runRound reads the room inside ledger.withRoomFence. In SCOPED, it opens round 1 by appending T2 (task.dispatched.planner, moving SCOPED -> PLANNING) and calling journal.appendJournaledInTransaction in the same database transaction with deterministic commandId = plannerCommandIdFor(roomId, triggerEventId) ('cmd_planner_' + first 32 hex chars of SHA-256('buildroom:planner-command:1\0' + roomId + '\0' + triggerEventId)). In PLANNING after T4 (plan.revision_requested), it opens a revision round whose commandId is derived from the T4 eventId and whose prompt includes the Founder's revision feedback and earlier plan hash. 3. Pre-contact Checks & Attestation: PlannerLoop.runRound checks preContactRefusal against AuthorizationCoverage, calls planner.attest(commandId, intendedRoute) over GatewayPlannerChannel, verifies the attested route matches intendedRoute, and appends identity_bound. 4. Dispatch & Execution on Gateway: PlannerLoop.runRound calls planner.dispatch(work). The Gateway's PrimaryLane polls POST /gateway/planner/poll with a signed PlannerPollEnvelope and passes requests to GatewayPlannerWorker, which persists per-command state under <gatewayDirectory>/planner and invokes AgyPlannerExecutor. AgyPlannerExecutor verifies Gateway identity 1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a (via boundGatewayReader), checks that no plannerUser process is running, verifies sha256OfFile(agyPath) === agySha256, creates a read-only git checkout at work.baseSha, and spawns sudo -n -u <plannerUser> -- <agyPath> chat --mode agent --print --output-format stream-json --model gemini-4-argon-high. Only after BoundedLineSplitter reads an init line with model === 'gemini-4-argon-high' and non-empty conversation_id does AgyPlannerExecutor write the durable evidence file <gatewayDirectory>/planner-evidence/<sha256(commandId)>.json and send agyInputLine(plannerPrompt(work)) to stdin. PlannerLoop.runRound records dispatched (using BRJ:c:2 when initModel and providerConversationId are both reported). 5. Plan Parsing, Judgement, and Completion (T3 + PlanStore + completed): AgyPlannerExecutor parses the result line from agy via parsePlanResponse / planDocumentFrom and returns the parsed plan document ({ kind: 'plan', document }). GatewayPlannerWorker checks boundedResult against MAX_PLANNER_PAYLOAD_BYTES and reports finished via a signed PlannerReportEnvelope to POST /gateway/planner/report. GatewayPlannerPort.awaitPlan returns the parsed plan document to PlannerLoop.runRound, which runs judgeRoundPlan (checking judgePlanDoc, terminalStatus === 'PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL', repository, baseSha, and that every plan scope path is in the T1 captured scope). Inside one fenced transaction, submitRoundPlan appends T3 (plan.submitted, moving PLANNING -> PLAN_REVIEW), calls PlanStore.recordPlan (which enforces the same-transaction xmin check on the T3 event and inserts into public.build_room_plans), and appends completed (which runs the JournalStore completion authorization query). 6. Founder Adjudication (T4 / T5 / T22): At POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision, decidePlan runs in one transaction to append the lifecycle transition and call journal.appendDecisionInTransaction: plan.approved (T5) verifies planHash against the stored plan and moves PLAN_REVIEW -> BUILDING (dispatching nothing further in Phase 4); plan.revision_requested (T4) verifies planHash, refuses credential-shaped feedback, and moves PLAN_REVIEW -> PLANNING; founder.cancel (T22) binds to the room's latest planner command (refused with 409 founder_cancel_command_in_flight while non-terminal, or 409 founder_cancel_no_planner_command before any command exists) and moves the room to CLOSED_ABANDONED. 7. Counted-Run Harness (npm run phase4:counted-run): Phase4Runner drives T1 and planner rounds through HttpPhase4Driver without ever sending a Founder decision; at plan_review, cli.ts saves plan-<planHash>.json in PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, and for Phase4-CR1 round 1 runs evaluatePhase4LiveCheck before pausing for the Founder's external decision.
trust_and_security_boundaries: 1. Database Role Separation & Identity Latch: public.command_journal_events and public.command_journal_chain_head are owned by br_journal_owner; public.command_journal_append is SECURITY DEFINER owned by command_journal_writer with EXECUTE granted only to br_app_runtime. In packages/control-plane/src/journal-store.ts, requireRuntimeIdentity queries SELECT session_user::text AS session_user, current_user::text AS current_user and throws JournalRuntimeNotAuthorizedError ('journal_runtime_not_authorized') unless both equal 'br_app_runtime' (nothing sets app.journal_writer). public.build_room_plans grants only SELECT and INSERT to br_app_runtime and enforces append-only triggers blocking UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE. 2. Route & Token Separation: GOVERNED_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS are blocked on POST /rooms/:roomId/events (403 governed_event_route_forbidden). POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision requires CONTROL_PLANE_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN (distinct from CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN). Counted-run routes require BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN and an active CountedRunConfig (BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_ACT, BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_GATEWAY_ID, BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_COMMIT_SHA, BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_FOUNDEROS_SHA, RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID, and pinned packages/control-plane/fixtures/execution-surface-registry.md at SHA-256 060a16a40abb58794cf960d33010bee006e06d4f699f32f61704d1ecd88e2055). 3. Signed Pull Channel: The control plane never connects inbound to the Gateway; the Gateway polls POST /gateway/planner/poll and reports to POST /gateway/planner/report using Ed25519-signed PlannerPollEnvelope and PlannerReportEnvelope bound to the active session epoch and sequence. 4. Executor Isolation & Redaction: AgyPlannerExecutor runs only on Linux for Gateway 1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a, launches agy under a separate OS user via sudo -n -u <plannerUser>, strips environment variables via childEnvironment, forbids BANNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS, enforces a read-only checkout (without following symlinks), and reaps leftover processes via sudo -n /usr/bin/pkill -KILL -u <plannerUser>. JournalStore, PlanStore, decidePlan, and cli.ts enforce credential-material redaction and refusal via containsCredentialMaterial and leaksSecret.

error_and_failure_behavior: 1. Planner Loop Failure Classifications: PLANNER_FAILURES in packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts comprises 12 classifications: 'authorization_does_not_cover', 'authorization_indeterminate', 'attestation_failed', 'identity_mismatch', 'not_sent', 'route_mismatch', 'planner_reported_failure', 'plan_invalid', 'plan_outside_captured_scope', 'plan_refused', 'completion_not_covered', and 'round_superseded'. 2. Pre-send Refusals: A refusal before sending is journaled as failed with classification 'authorization_does_not_cover', 'authorization_indeterminate', 'attestation_failed', or 'identity_mismatch' (there is no pre_send_refusal). 3. Plan Judgement & Refusal Logging: When judgeRoundPlan refuses a returned plan, the round is journaled as failed with classification 'plan_invalid' or 'plan_outside_captured_scope', and logPlanRefused logs planner.plan_refused with PlanRefusalReason kind in {'schema', 'scope_path', 'encoding', 'not_ready', 'outside_captured_scope'}. When PlanStore.recordPlan throws PlanRefusedError for 'credential_material', the round is journaled as failed with classification 'plan_refused' and writes no planner.plan_refused log line. 4. Unresolved & Recovery: If dispatch or awaitPlan throws or completion coverage is indeterminate, PlannerLoop.runRound journals unresolved and leaves the room in PLANNING. PlannerRecovery.reconcileAll queries the Planner by commandId without re-dispatching: 'never_received' on a non-dispatched command journals failed ('not_sent'); reconciled answers finish or fail the round; mismatches or 'unknown' remain unresolved. 5. Executor Halting: AgyPlannerExecutor writes <gatewayDirectory>/planner-halted.json and refuses subsequent commands if a pre-launch process probe fails or finds leftover processes, if evidence writing fails, if post-run reap leaves processes, or if checkout removal fails. 6. Runner Live-Check Stop: In packages/run-harness/src/phase4/runner.ts, Phase4Runner never sends founder.cancel or any other decision; if afterRound (such as evaluatePhase4LiveCheck on Phase4-CR1 round 1) returns 'stop', the runner stops its loop and records outcome 'interrupted' with 'stopped_after_round' in failures.
observability: 1. Command Journal & Ledger Endpoints: GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal exposes the room's command histories and decision records; GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan exposes the judged stored plan in PLAN_REVIEW or BUILDING; GET /rooms/:roomId/export exposes the room's lifecycle transitions. 2. Structured Refusal Log: planner.plan_refused is emitted via PlannerLog warn (in PlannerLoop and PlannerRecovery) only when judgeRoundPlan refuses a plan, logging roomId, commandId, round, classification ('plan_invalid' or 'plan_outside_captured_scope'), and sanitized reason metadata (kind in {'schema', 'scope_path', 'encoding', 'not_ready', 'outside_captured_scope'}, rule, path, and lengths) without echoing plan-authored strings. 3. Gateway Durable Records: GatewayPlannerWorker writes command records under <gatewayDirectory>/planner; AgyPlannerExecutor writes <gatewayDirectory>/planner-evidence/<sha256(commandId)>.json (recording commandId, roomId, round, baseSha, agySha256, initModel, providerConversationId, checkoutRemoved, and outcome) and halt marker <gatewayDirectory>/planner-halted.json. 4. Counted-Run Evidence Files: npm run phase4:counted-run writes attempt history to attempts.json (PHASE4_ATTEMPTS_FILE), lock file run.lock (PHASE4_LOCK_FILE), retrieved plans at plan_review to plan-<planHash>.json in PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, and run records to <label>-<roomId>.record.json and <label>-<roomId>.record.sha256.
